description: Asynchronous job request to execute a batch of update operations against a grid session. Patches are attributed to the caller's replica. Does not require a WebSocket connection.

sessionId.description: Required. The grid session ID to update.

replicaId.description: Required. The caller's replica ID. Patches are attributed to this replica for cell-level attribution and sync change detection. Must be owned by the caller.

updateRequest.description: Required. The batch of update operations to execute.
